blocks.html:
The result of deleting a search index. Every physical index built for it is
dropped, so the next migration rebuilds it from scratch at version 1.

types.name: id
types.description: The name of the deleted index.

types.name: object
types.description: The type of the item that was deleted.

types.name: deleted
types.description: Whether the index was deleted successfully.

types.name: deleted_versions
types.description:
How many of the index's versions were dropped. `0` when the index is
registered but was never migrated.
